b: For clarity, this is us trialing the migration of Fresh Topic Friday to Saturday.
Every Saturday, posts are withheld for review by the moderators and approved if they aren't highly similar to another made in the past month.

We do this to reduce topic fatigue for our regular contributors, and encourage people to post about topics that aren't as frequently discussed. If you have a take about something that doesn't overlap too much with the most commonly discussed issues in the current zeitgeist, we'd love to see it here today!
See here for a full explanation of Switch-It-Up Saturday.
If you would like to know if your post would qualify or have any other questions, feel free to message the moderators!
